steps: Hold your hands up in front of you with your fingers straight and together.

Move slowly through each shape: a hook with the fingers bent at the middle and end joints, a full fist, a flat tabletop bent at the knuckles, and a straight fist with fingertips at the base of the palm.
Return to straight fingers after each shape and keep every movement smooth and pain-free.
One pass through all of the shapes is one rep.

name: Seated Cat-Cow
steps: Sit near the front of a chair with your feet flat and your hands on your knees.
Inhale, roll your pelvis forward, lift your chest and draw your shoulders back to arch your spine gently.
Exhale, roll your pelvis back, round your spine and let your chin drop toward your chest.
Flow slowly between the two shapes with your breath, moving the whole spine rather than only the neck.

name: Seated Ankle Pumps
steps: Sit tall with your legs extended or your heels resting lightly on the floor.
Pull your toes up toward your shins as far as is comfortable, feeling the calves lengthen.
Then point your toes away from you, feeling the front of the ankles stretch.
Keep a steady rhythm through the full range; up and down together count as one rep.

name: Standing Pelvic Circles
steps: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, knees soft and hands on your hips.
Slowly draw a large circle with your hips, moving them forward, to one side, back and to the other side.
Keep your head and shoulders roughly still over your feet so the movement comes from your pelvis.
Complete the reps in one direction, then reverse.

name: Lower Trunk Rotations
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent, feet flat and together, and arms out to the sides.
Keeping your knees together, slowly lower them to one side as far as is comfortable while your shoulders stay on the floor.
Use your abdominals to bring the knees back through the centre and over to the other side.
Move smoothly within a pain-free range; each side counts as one rep.

name: Hamstring Sweeps
steps: Step one foot slightly forward onto the heel with the toes up and the leg straight, back knee soft.
Hinge at the hips and sweep both hands down and forward past the front foot in a scooping motion, keeping your back flat.
Feel a light stretch behind the front leg, then rise, step forward and repeat on the other leg.
Keep the pace smooth and rhythmic instead of bouncing.

name: Walking Quad Pull
steps: Take a step, then bend your back knee and catch that ankle with the same-side hand, drawing the heel toward your buttock.
Reach the opposite arm overhead and rise onto the toes of your standing foot for a moment.
Release, step forward and repeat on the other side.
Keep your knees close together and your torso upright instead of leaning forward.

name: Reverse Lunge with Overhead Reach
steps: Stand tall, then step one foot back into a lunge and lower your back knee toward the floor.
As you lower, reach both arms overhead and lean slightly away from the back leg to feel a stretch at the front of that hip.
Squeeze the glute of the back leg and keep your front knee over the ankle.
Push through your front foot to return to standing and alternate legs.

name: Half-Kneeling Hip Flexor Rocks
steps: Kneel on one knee on a pad with the other foot flat in front, both knees bent to about 90 degrees.
Squeeze the glute of the kneeling leg and tuck your tailbone slightly to set your pelvis.
Rock your hips forward until you feel a stretch at the front of the kneeling hip, pause for a second, then rock back.
Keep your torso upright and ribs down instead of arching your lower back to go further.

name: Down Dog Calf Pedals
steps: Start in Downward-Facing Dog with your hands shoulder-width apart and hips high.
Bend one knee and lift that heel while you press the other heel toward the floor.
Switch smoothly, pedalling from one leg to the other and pausing briefly as each heel lowers.
Keep your hips steady and spine long; it is fine if your heels do not reach the floor.

name: Crab Reach
steps: Sit with your knees bent, feet flat and hands on the floor behind you, fingers pointing back.
Press through your feet and one hand to lift your hips, then reach your other arm up and over your head toward the far side.
Let your chest open toward the ceiling and squeeze your glutes at the top, keeping your neck relaxed.
Lower your hips with control and alternate sides.

name: Windmill Toe Touches
steps: Stand with your feet wide and your arms stretched out to the sides at shoulder height.
Hinge at the hips and rotate to bring one hand toward the opposite foot while the other arm reaches up toward the ceiling.
Return to standing and repeat to the other side with a smooth, controlled rhythm.
Bend your knees as needed instead of rounding hard to reach the foot.

name: Seated Saw
steps: Sit tall with your legs straight and wider than your hips, feet flexed and arms out to the sides at shoulder height.
Rotate your torso toward one leg, then exhale and reach the opposite hand past the little-toe side of that foot as you fold forward.
Let your back arm reach behind you as you feel a stretch through the hamstring and the back of the shoulder.
Inhale to sit tall, return to the centre and alternate sides; sit on a cushion if your lower back rounds.

name: Standing Roll-Down
steps: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your knees soft.
Tuck your chin and slowly roll down one vertebra at a time with your arms hanging, until your hands are near the floor.
Pause and breathe, then roll back up from the base of your spine, stacking your head last.
Bend your knees more if you feel strain in your lower back.

name: A-March
steps: Stand tall, then drive one knee up to hip height with the ankle flexed and toes pulled up.
Swing the opposite arm forward in rhythm as you rise onto the ball of your standing foot.
Step the foot down under your hip and repeat with the other leg as you travel forward.
Keep your torso upright and the movement crisp instead of leaning back.

name: Ball Pec Release
steps: Place a massage or lacrosse ball just below your collarbone toward the front of the shoulder, and lean that side into a wall.
Lean in until you feel firm but tolerable pressure, then make small circles or slow arm sweeps.
Stay off the collarbone and armpit, and move the ball if you feel tingling or sharp pain.
Breathe slowly through the hold, then switch sides.

name: Ball Upper Trap Release
steps: Stand with your back to a wall and place a massage ball between the wall and the muscle between your neck and shoulder blade.
Bend your knees slightly and lean back into the ball, letting your shoulder relax.
Roll slowly over tender spots, pausing for a few breaths on each.
Keep the ball off your spine and neck bones, then switch sides.

name: Upward Salute
steps: Stand in Mountain Pose with your feet hip-width apart and your weight even across both feet.
Inhale and sweep your arms out and up overhead, palms facing each other or touching.
Lengthen up through your fingertips while your shoulders stay away from your ears and your lower ribs stay soft.
Lift your gaze toward your thumbs without squeezing the back of your neck.

name: Half Standing Forward Bend
steps: From a standing forward fold, place your hands on your shins or your fingertips on the floor.
Inhale and lift your chest forward so your spine is long and flat, roughly parallel to the floor.
Draw your shoulders away from your ears and look slightly ahead of your toes, keeping your neck long.
Bend your knees as much as you need to keep your back from rounding.

name: Plank Pose
steps: From hands and knees, step your feet back so your body forms a straight line from head to heels, hands under your shoulders.
Spread your fingers, press the floor away and draw your belly in so your hips neither sag nor pike up.
Reach back through your heels and forward through the crown of your head.
Lower your knees to the mat for an easier version, keeping a straight line from knees to head.

name: Four-Limbed Staff Pose
steps: From Plank Pose, shift forward slightly onto the balls of your feet so your shoulders move ahead of your wrists.
Bend your elbows straight back, hugging them to your ribs, and lower until your upper arms are parallel to the floor.
Keep your body in one line and your shoulders level with your elbows instead of dipping lower.
Lower your knees first if you cannot hold the line, then press back up or move into the next pose.

name: Knees-Chest-Chin Pose
steps: From Plank Pose, lower your knees to the mat.
Keeping your hips high, bend your elbows close to your sides and lower your chest and chin to the floor between your hands.
Your knees, chest, chin, hands and feet touch the mat while your hips stay lifted.
Move slowly with your elbows hugging in, then slide forward into Cobra Pose.

name: Three-Legged Dog
steps: Start in Downward-Facing Dog with your hands and feet firmly planted.
Inhale and lift one leg straight up behind you, reaching through the heel while your hips stay level.
Keep pressing evenly through both hands and the standing heel, shoulders away from your ears.
For a hip opener, bend the lifted knee and let that hip open, then lower the leg and switch sides.

name: Reverse Warrior
steps: From Warrior II, keep your front knee bent over the ankle and your hips low.
Turn your front palm up and reach that arm overhead and back while your other hand slides lightly down the back leg.
Lengthen the whole side of your body from the front hip to the fingertips without sinking into the back hand.
Hold for a few breaths, return to Warrior II and switch sides.

name: Humble Warrior
steps: From Warrior I, interlace your hands behind your back and straighten your arms.
Exhale and fold your torso forward inside the front knee, letting your clasped hands reach up and over your head.
Keep the front knee bent over the ankle and the back foot grounded as your shoulders and back hip open.
Inhale to rise slowly, release your hands and switch sides.

name: Revolved Side Angle Pose
steps: From a high lunge with your back heel lifted, place your hands on either side of your front foot.
Move the hand opposite your front leg to the floor or a block outside the front foot.
Twist your chest toward the front leg and reach your top arm up or alongside your ear.
Keep the front knee over the ankle and lengthen your spine before twisting deeper, then switch sides.

name: Revolved High Lunge
steps: Step into a high lunge with your back heel lifted and your front knee bent over the ankle.
Bring your palms together at your chest, then exhale and rotate toward the front leg, hooking the opposite elbow outside the front knee.
Press your palms together to turn your chest toward the side, keeping the back leg straight and active.
Lengthen your spine on each inhale and twist a little more on each exhale, then switch sides.

name: Revolved Low Lunge
steps: From Low Lunge with your back knee on a padded mat, place your hands on either side of your front foot.
Keep the hand opposite your front leg on the floor or a block and reach the other arm up toward the ceiling as you rotate your chest.
Let your back hip sink forward slightly to keep a gentle stretch at the front of that hip.
Twist from your upper back without forcing it, then return to the centre and switch sides.

name: Crescent Moon Pose
steps: Stand in Mountain Pose, sweep your arms overhead and interlace your fingers with the index fingers pointing up.
Ground through both feet and lift through your fingertips, then lean your upper body to one side.
Press the opposite hip gently out to the side so you feel the stretch along that whole side of your body.
Keep your chest facing forward instead of rolling it toward the floor, then return to the centre and switch sides.

name: Star Pose
steps: Stand with your feet wide, roughly one leg-length apart, toes pointing forward.
Lift your arms out to the sides at shoulder height, palms down, so your body forms a star.
Reach actively through your fingertips and press down through the outer edges of your feet.
Keep your knees soft, ribs drawn in and shoulders away from your ears as you breathe steadily.

name: Goddess Pose
steps: Stand with your feet wide and your toes turned out about 45 degrees.
Bend your knees and lower your hips toward knee height, tracking your knees over your toes.
Lift your arms into a goalpost shape or bring your palms together, keeping your torso upright and tailbone pointing down.
Hold with steady breathing, and rise a little if your knees start to roll inward.

name: Revolved Chair Pose
steps: From Chair Pose, bring your palms together at the centre of your chest.
Exhale and twist, hooking one elbow outside the opposite knee.
Keep your knees level and side by side and your hips low as you turn your chest up from your upper back.
Return to the centre on an inhale and switch sides.

name: Wide-Legged Forward Fold
steps: Stand with your feet three to four feet apart, toes pointing forward or slightly in, hands on your hips.
Inhale to lengthen your spine, then exhale and hinge forward from your hips with a flat back.
Place your hands on the floor under your shoulders or on blocks and let the crown of your head move toward the floor.
Keep weight in the outer edges of your feet, soften your knees if the backs of your legs strain, and rise slowly with a flat back.

name: Revolved Wide-Legged Forward Fold
steps: From Wide-Legged Forward Fold, place one hand on the floor or a block directly under your face.
Inhale and reach your other arm up toward the ceiling, rotating your chest open.
Keep both hips level and your weight even between your feet as you twist through your upper back.
Lower the hand and repeat to the other side.

name: Half Moon Pose
steps: From Triangle Pose, bend your front knee and place your front fingertips on the floor or a block about a foot ahead of the front foot.
Shift your weight into the front leg and lift the back leg until it is level with your hip, foot flexed.
Stack your top hip over the bottom one and reach your top arm toward the ceiling.
Keep the standing knee soft and look down if balancing is hard, then switch sides.

name: Revolved Half Moon Pose
steps: From a standing split or Warrior III, place the hand opposite your standing leg on a block or the floor under your shoulder.
Keep the lifted leg level with your hip, toes pointing down, and square both hips toward the floor.
Rotate your chest away from the floor and reach your other arm up, turning from your upper back instead of your lower back.
Hold for a few steady breaths, then lower with control and switch sides.

name: Dancer's Pose
steps: Stand on one leg, bend the other knee and hold the inside of that foot or ankle with the same-side hand.
Reach your free arm forward and up, then press the foot back into your hand as you tip your chest slightly forward.
Let the lifted leg rise behind you while your hips stay square and your standing knee stays soft.
Rest your front hand on a wall if balance is shaky, then lower slowly and switch sides.

name: Extended Hand-to-Big-Toe Pose
steps: Stand on one leg and draw the other knee up toward your chest.
Hold the big toe with your first two fingers, or loop a strap around the ball of the foot.
Slowly extend the lifted leg forward as far as you can while keeping your chest tall and hips level.
Keep the knee bent if your back starts to round, then switch legs.

name: Standing Split
steps: From a standing forward fold, place your hands on the floor or on blocks a little in front of your feet.
Shift your weight into one leg and lift the other straight up behind you, toes pointing down.
Keep your hips square to the floor and let your head hang toward the standing shin.
Soften the standing knee if your hamstrings pull, then lower the leg with control and switch sides.

name: Standing Figure Four Pose
steps: Stand tall, shift onto one leg and cross the other ankle over the standing knee, flexing that foot.
Bend the standing knee and sit your hips back as if into a chair.
Bring your palms to your chest or rest them on the crossed shin, and hinge forward slightly until the outer hip of the crossed leg stretches.
Hold a wall or chair for balance if needed, then stand up slowly and switch sides.

name: Side Lunge Pose
steps: Start in a wide stance with your toes turned slightly out.
Bend one knee deeply and sit your hips toward that heel while the other leg stays straight with its toes pointing up.
Keep your chest lifted with your hands on the floor or pressed together at your chest for balance.
Keep the bent heel down if you can, or rest it on a folded mat, then shift through the centre to the other side.

name: Standing Backbend
steps: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and place your palms on your lower back, fingers pointing down.
Inhale and lift your chest, drawing your elbows toward each other.
Exhale and lean back gently, pressing your hips slightly forward and keeping your chin level instead of dropping your head back.
Keep the bend small and stop before any pinching in your lower back, then return upright on an inhale.

name: Half Splits
steps: From Low Lunge with your back knee on the mat, shift your hips back over the back knee.
Straighten your front leg and flex the front foot so the toes point up, hands on the floor or blocks.
Hinge forward from your hips with a long spine until you feel the stretch along the back of the front leg.
Keep your hips stacked over the back knee instead of rounding forward, then switch sides.

name: Monkey Pose
steps: Begin in Half Splits with blocks under your hands on either side of the front leg.
Slowly slide the front heel forward and the back knee back, lowering your hips only as far as you stay in control.
Keep your hips squared to the front, with a bolster or block under the front thigh for support.
Never bounce or force the last part of the range; come out by bending the front knee and sliding back.

name: Gate Pose
steps: Kneel upright with your hips over your knees, then extend one leg out to the side with the foot flat and toes forward.
Rest the hand on that side on the straight leg and reach your other arm up overhead.
Bend your torso over the straight leg, reaching up and over so the long side of your body opens.
Keep your chest facing forward and pad the kneeling knee, then return upright and switch sides.

name: Side Plank Pose
steps: From Plank Pose, roll onto the outer edge of one foot and stack the other foot on top.
Turn your body to the side, press through the bottom hand directly under your shoulder and reach your top arm toward the ceiling.
Lift your hips so your body forms one line from head to heels.
Lower your bottom knee to the mat for support if needed, then return to plank and switch sides.

name: Crow Pose
steps: Squat with your feet together and knees wide, and plant your hands shoulder-width apart on the mat in front of you.
Bend your elbows slightly back and place your knees high on the backs of your upper arms.
Lean forward to shift weight into your hands and lift one foot, then the other, drawing your heels toward your buttocks.
Look slightly ahead instead of down, keep a cushion in front of you while learning and lower your feet with control.

name: Side Crow Pose
steps: Squat on the balls of your feet with your knees together, then twist to place both hands on the mat outside one thigh, shoulder-width apart.
Bend your elbows straight back and rest the outer thigh on the shelf of the upper arm nearer your knees.
Lean forward into your hands and lift your feet, keeping your knees together and hips high.
Keep a cushion in front of your face while learning, then lower with control and switch sides.

name: Dolphin Pose
steps: Start on hands and knees, then lower your forearms to the mat with your elbows under your shoulders.
Tuck your toes and lift your hips up and back into an inverted V, like Downward-Facing Dog on your forearms.
Press your forearms down and lift your shoulders away from the floor so your chest moves toward your thighs.
Keep your knees bent if your back rounds, and keep your head off the floor.

name: Tabletop Pose
steps: Come onto your hands and knees with your wrists under your shoulders and knees under your hips.
Spread your fingers wide and press evenly through both hands.
Lengthen your spine from tailbone to the crown of your head, keeping your back flat and your gaze down.
Draw your belly in lightly so your lower back does not sag.

name: Staff Pose
steps: Sit with your legs together and straight out in front of you, feet flexed.
Place your hands on the floor beside your hips, fingers forward, and press down to lift your chest.
Sit up on your sitting bones with your shoulders stacked over your hips.
Sit on a folded blanket and bend your knees slightly if your lower back rounds.

name: Easy Pose
steps: Sit cross-legged with each foot beneath the opposite knee or shin.
Sit on the edge of a folded blanket so your knees can relax toward the floor and your spine stays tall.
Rest your hands on your knees or thighs, soften your shoulders and breathe slowly.
Switch which leg is in front each time you practise.

name: Half Lotus Pose
steps: Sit in Easy Pose on a folded blanket so your knees are close to the floor.
Lift one foot and rest it on top of the opposite thigh, sole facing up, rotating from the hip instead of twisting the knee.
Let your other foot rest under the opposite knee and sit tall with your hands on your knees.
Come out straight away if you feel any pain in the knee, and switch legs each time you practise.

name: Hero Pose
steps: Kneel with your knees together and your feet slightly wider than your hips, tops of the feet on the floor.
Sit your hips down between your heels, or on a block if they do not reach the floor comfortably.
Ease your calves slightly outward with your hands as you sit so your knees are not twisted.
Sit tall with your hands on your thighs, and come out right away if you feel knee pain.

name: Reclined Hero Pose
steps: From Hero Pose, with a block under your hips if needed, place your hands on the floor behind you.
Lean back slowly onto your forearms, then onto a bolster or the floor if your knees and back allow.
Keep your knees close together and down, stopping at the height where your thighs stretch without knee or lower back pain.
To come out, press up onto your forearms and hands before lifting your hips.

name: Head-to-Knee Pose
steps: Sit with one leg straight and bend the other knee, placing that foot against the inner thigh of the straight leg.
Turn your chest to face the straight leg and inhale to lengthen your spine.
Exhale and fold forward from your hips over the straight leg, holding the shin, the ankle or a strap around the foot.
Lead with your chest instead of pulling your head toward the knee, then switch sides.

name: Revolved Head-to-Knee Pose
steps: Sit with one leg extended out to the side and the other knee bent, its foot against the inner thigh.
Lean the side of your torso toward the straight leg, resting that forearm inside the leg or the hand on the shin.
Reach your top arm overhead toward the extended foot and turn your chest up toward the ceiling.
Keep both sitting bones grounded and breathe into the long side of your body, then switch sides.

name: Wide-Angle Seated Forward Bend
steps: Sit with your legs wide apart in a comfortable V, kneecaps and toes pointing up.
Place your hands on the floor in front of you and inhale to sit tall on your sitting bones.
Exhale and walk your hands forward, folding from your hips with a long spine.
Sit on a folded blanket if your lower back rounds, and do not let your knees roll inward.

name: Marichi's Pose
steps: Sit in Staff Pose, then bend one knee and place that foot flat on the floor close to the same-side sitting bone.
Reach the arm on the bent-knee side forward inside the shin, then wrap it around the shin and behind you.
Reach your other arm behind you to clasp hands or a strap, then fold forward over the straight leg.
Keep the bent knee pointing up and lead with your chest, then switch sides.

name: Bharadvaja's Twist
steps: Sit with both knees bent and your legs folded to one side, feet resting beside the opposite hip.
Inhale and sit tall, then exhale and turn your chest away from your feet.
Place the hand on the side you are turning toward on the floor behind you and the other hand on the outside of the opposite knee.
Keep both sitting bones heavy, with a blanket under your hips if needed, then switch sides.

name: Fire Log Pose
steps: Sit tall and place one shin parallel to the front edge of the mat.
Stack the other shin on top so the top ankle rests just past the bottom knee, both feet flexed.
Fill any gap under the top knee with a block or blanket, then walk your hands forward to fold if your hips allow.
Back off if you feel pressure in the knees rather than a stretch in the outer hips, and switch which shin is on top.

name: Easy Pose Forward Fold
steps: Sit in Easy Pose on a folded blanket with your shins crossed.
Inhale to lengthen your spine, then exhale and walk your hands forward on the floor.
Let your torso drape forward and rest your forehead on a block if it does not reach the floor.
Walk back up slowly, cross your legs the other way and repeat.

name: Shoelace Pose
steps: From sitting, cross one knee directly over the other so your knees stack and your feet rest beside the opposite hips.
Sit evenly on both sitting bones, using a blanket under your hips if one side lifts.
Stay upright or walk your hands forward to fold for a deeper stretch in the outer hips.
Uncross your legs slowly and switch which knee is on top.

name: Frog Pose
steps: From hands and knees, slide your knees wide apart on padding, ankles in line with your knees and feet flexed.
Lower onto your forearms and let your hips sink back gently toward your heels.
Keep your shins parallel and your lower back long instead of letting it sag.
Ease in slowly, stop at a stretch along your inner thighs and walk your knees back together to come out.

name: Upward Plank Pose
steps: Sit in Staff Pose and place your hands on the floor behind your hips, fingers pointing toward your feet.
Press into your hands and heels to lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to feet.
Point your toes toward the floor and open your chest, keeping your neck neutral unless releasing your head back feels comfortable.
Bend your knees into Reverse Tabletop Pose if your shoulders or hamstrings complain.

name: Reverse Tabletop Pose
steps: Sit with your knees bent, feet flat and hip-width apart, and your hands behind you with fingers pointing toward your feet.
Press through your hands and feet to lift your hips until your thighs and torso are level, knees over ankles.
Open across the front of your shoulders and chest, keeping your chin slightly tucked.
Lower your hips gently and shake out your wrists between holds.

name: Bow Pose
steps: Lie on your belly, bend your knees and reach back to hold the outsides of your ankles.
Inhale and press your feet back into your hands, letting that pull lift your chest and thighs off the floor.
Keep your knees no wider than your hips and your neck long, gazing forward.
Breathe steadily, then release slowly and rest with your head turned to one side.

name: Fish Pose
steps: Lie on your back with your legs straight and slide your hands under your hips, palms down.
Press into your forearms to lift your chest, then lower the crown of your head lightly to the floor with most of your weight in your arms.
Lift through your breastbone and keep your neck from carrying much weight.
For a gentler version, rest your upper back on a block or bolster and let your head rest on the floor.

name: Wild Thing
steps: From Three-Legged Dog, bend the lifted knee and open that hip toward the ceiling.
Pivot onto the outer edge of your standing foot as you flip the lifted foot over and place it on the floor behind you, knee bent.
Lift your hips and chest, reaching the free arm overhead while the bottom hand presses firmly down.
Move into it slowly with the supporting shoulder strong, then return the way you came and switch sides.

name: Wheel Pose
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent and heels close to your buttocks, then place your hands beside your ears, fingers pointing toward your shoulders.
Press into your feet and hands to lift your hips and rest briefly on the crown of your head, keeping your elbows from splaying.
Straighten your arms to lift your head and chest, letting the backbend spread through your whole spine.
Keep your knees and feet parallel, and come down by tucking your chin and lowering slowly onto your upper back.

name: Supported Shoulder Stand
steps: Lie on your back with folded blankets under your shoulders and your head on the floor, then lift your legs and hips overhead.
Support your back with your hands, elbows shoulder-width apart, and walk your hands toward your shoulder blades.
Straighten your legs toward the ceiling with your weight on your shoulders and upper arms, not your neck.
Never turn your head while you are up; roll down slowly one vertebra at a time, and skip this pose if you have neck problems.

name: Plow Pose
steps: Lie on your back with a folded blanket under your shoulders and your arms by your sides.
Press into your arms to lift your legs and hips up and over, lowering your toes toward the floor behind your head.
Support your back with your hands or interlace them on the floor, keeping your weight on your shoulders instead of your neck.
Rest your feet on a chair if they do not reach the floor, keep your head still and roll out slowly.

name: Supported Bridge Pose
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat, hip-width apart.
Lift your hips and slide a yoga block or firm cushion under your sacrum, the flat bone at the base of your spine.
Lower your weight onto the support and let your arms rest by your sides, palms up.
Breathe slowly and let your hips relax, then lift your hips to remove the block before you come out.

name: Reclined Bound Angle Pose
steps: Lie on your back, bring the soles of your feet together and let your knees fall open to the sides.
Place cushions or blocks under your thighs so you feel a mild stretch instead of a strain in the groin.
Rest your arms by your sides, or place one hand on your belly and one on your chest.
Breathe slowly, and to come out use your hands to bring your knees together before rolling to the side.

name: Reclined Pigeon Pose
steps: Lie on your back with both knees bent and cross one ankle over the opposite knee, flexing the crossed foot.
Lift the bottom foot off the floor and thread your hands behind that thigh.
Draw the bottom thigh toward your chest until you feel a stretch in the outer hip of the crossed leg.
Keep your head and shoulders relaxed on the floor, then switch sides.

name: Reclined Hand-to-Big-Toe Pose
steps: Lie on your back with both legs straight and loop a strap around the ball of one foot.
Raise that leg toward the ceiling, holding the strap in both hands and keeping the other leg long on the floor.
Draw the leg toward you until the back of the thigh stretches, keeping both hips on the floor.
Hold the big toe instead of the strap only if you can do it without lifting your head, then switch legs.

name: Wind-Relieving Pose
steps: Lie on your back and draw both knees toward your chest.
Wrap your arms around your shins, or hold behind your thighs if that is kinder to your knees.
Let your lower back and shoulders relax toward the floor as you breathe into your belly.
Rock gently from side to side to massage your lower back, then release your feet to the floor.

name: Banana Pose
steps: Lie on your back with your legs straight and your arms overhead, holding opposite elbows if comfortable.
Keeping your hips and shoulders on the floor, walk your feet and upper body toward the same side so your body forms a gentle crescent.
Cross the ankle on the stretched side over the other ankle to deepen the stretch along that side of your body.
Relax and breathe into the long side ribs, then return to the centre and switch sides.

name: Constructive Rest Pose
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat and wider than your hips.
Let your knees fall in to rest against each other so your legs can relax completely.
Rest your hands on your belly or the floor and let your lower back settle without pressing it down.
Breathe slowly for a few minutes, then roll to one side to come up.

name: Crocodile Pose
steps: Lie face down with your legs slightly apart and your toes turned in or out, whichever is comfortable.
Fold your arms in front of you and rest your forehead on your stacked hands or forearms.
Breathe slowly into your belly and feel your lower back rise and fall with each breath.
Stay relaxed for a few minutes, then press back slowly into a child's pose before sitting up.

name: Reverse Prayer Pose
steps: Stand or sit tall and bring your hands behind your back, backs of the hands together and fingers pointing down.
Rotate your wrists so your fingers point up and slide your hands up your spine, pressing your palms together as much as you can.
Roll your shoulders back and open your chest, drawing your elbows gently back.
If your palms do not meet, hold opposite elbows or forearms behind your back instead.

name: Half Sun Salutation
steps: Stand in Mountain Pose and inhale as you sweep your arms overhead into Upward Salute.
Exhale and fold forward from your hips, bending your knees as needed.
Inhale to a half lift with a flat back, then exhale to fold again.
Inhale to rise all the way up with your arms overhead, exhale your hands to your chest and repeat with your breath.

name: Sun Salutation B
steps: From Mountain Pose, inhale into Chair Pose with your arms overhead, then exhale and fold forward.
Inhale to a half lift, then step back and lower through Four-Limbed Staff Pose on an exhale, Upward-Facing Dog on an inhale and Downward-Facing Dog on an exhale.
Inhale and step your right foot forward into Warrior I, then repeat the plank, lowering, Upward-Facing Dog and Downward-Facing Dog sequence.
Repeat Warrior I on the left side and flow back to Downward-Facing Dog for five breaths.
Step forward, half lift, fold, and inhale back up into Chair Pose before standing in Mountain Pose.

name: Classical Sun Salutation
steps: From Mountain Pose, inhale your arms overhead, then exhale and fold forward.
Inhale and step your right foot back into Low Lunge, then step your left foot back to plank as you exhale.
Lower your knees, chest and chin to the floor, slide into Cobra Pose on an inhale and press back to Downward-Facing Dog on an exhale.
Inhale and step your right foot forward into Low Lunge, then exhale and bring the back foot forward to fold.
Inhale to rise with your arms overhead and return to Mountain Pose, leading with the left leg on the next round.

name: Vinyasa Transition
steps: From Plank Pose, exhale and lower through Four-Limbed Staff Pose, or lower your knees, chest and chin to the mat.
Inhale and roll over your toes into Upward-Facing Dog, or lift into Cobra Pose with your legs on the floor.
Exhale and lift your hips back into Downward-Facing Dog.
Keep each movement linked to your breath, and skip the lowering phase if your shoulders tire.

name: Moon Salutation
steps: From Mountain Pose, reach your arms overhead and lean into Crescent Moon Pose to each side.
Step wide into Goddess Pose, then straighten your legs into Star Pose with your arms wide.
Turn into Triangle Pose and then Pyramid Pose on one side, then lower into Low Lunge and on into Side Lunge Pose.
Pass through Garland Pose at the centre and mirror the sequence on the other side to return to Mountain Pose.

name: Dancing Warrior Flow
steps: Start in Warrior II with your front knee bent over the ankle and your arms reaching wide.
Inhale and tip back into Reverse Warrior, reaching the front arm up and overhead.
Exhale and lower your front forearm to your thigh, or your hand to a block, for Extended Side Angle Pose with the top arm over your ear.
Flow between the three shapes with your breath for several rounds, then switch sides.
